home.heroSubtitle: Book your procurement slot, track your queue, know your status and get timely updates. All in one place.
home.feature1Desc: Choose a convenient procurement date and time.
home.feature2Desc: Know your queue position and estimated waiting time.
home.feature3Desc: Get instant digital entry passes for quick entry at the centre.
home.feature4Desc: Receive updates on your slot, procurement and payment status.
home.step1Desc: Create your profile using Aadhaar or Mobile number.
home.step2Desc: Specify your crop type and estimated quantity.
home.step3Desc: Select your preferred procurement centre, date, and arrival time.
home.step4Desc: Track real-time queue and get your digital Gate Pass.
home.step5Desc: Arrive at the procurement centre to hand over produce and complete process.

slotBooking.heading: Procurement Slot Booking
slotBooking.subheading: Step-by-step allocation for grain hand-over and direct DBT clearance.
slotBooking.farmerRegistrySub: Ensure details match your land records for seamless APMC verification.
slotBooking.selectMandiDateSub: Choose a convenient procurement hub and book your delivery window to avoid long queues.
slotBooking.reviewSub: Verify your registration details before final gate pass generation.
slotBooking.inst1: Please ensure your Aadhaar card is linked to your registered mobile number for smooth e-KYC.
slotBooking.inst2: Please bring your digital or printed Gate Pass to the APMC checkpoint for fast-track entry.
slotBooking.inst3: Keep crop land registries (Girdawari documents) ready for grain inspection.
slotBooking.inst4: Moisture level of grains should ideally be under 14% to avoid processing delays.
slotBooking.gatePassSub: Present this QR token at the APMC entry weighbridge.
